entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Grihasthi Store Station Road, Ward No. 10, Nagar Parishard, Supaul
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text: Petitioner/s  Versus 1. The State of Bihar through the Principal Secretary, Department of Food and  Civil Supplies, Government of Bihar, Patna 2.
The Commissioner Koshi Division, Saharsa, District-Saharsa 3. The Designated Officer Koshi Division, Saharsa, District-Saharsa 4.
The Food Safety Officer Koshi Division, Saharsa, District-Saharsa 5.
The District Officer Supaul, Dist-Supaul 6. The Additional Collector-cum-Adjudicating Officer Supaul, District-Supaul
For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Amrit Abhijat, Advocate  For the Respondent/s : Mr. S. Raza Ahmad, AAG-5

======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE  and  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PARTHA SARTHY  ORAL JUDGMENT (Per: HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE) Date : 01-11-2022 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

The petitioner has prayed for the following relief/s :-
"A) To issue a writ in the nature of certiorari setting aside the order dated 09.12.17 passed by Additional Collector-cum-Adjudicating Officer, Supaul in Adjudication Case No. 04/2017, directing petitioner to deposit fine of Rs.1 lakh for contravention of Section 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, "for short would be referred as Act, 2006.
B) And/or any other order(s), direction(s), writ/writs Patna High Court CWJC No.7179 of 2019 dt.01-11-2022 for granting and other relief of reliefs to which the petitioner is found entitled to in the facts and circumstances of this case."

In view of equally alternative efficacious remedy, as provided, under section 70 of the Food Safety M/S Grihasthi Store vs The State Of Bihar on 1 November, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/73131339/
1 and Standards Act, 2006, the present petition, as prayed for, is disposed of reserving liberty to the petitioner to initiate proceedings, in accordance with law.

The present petition stands disposed of in the aforesaid terms.
Interlocutory application, if any, stands disposed of.
